drafter.private_reasoning: I kept the response commercially constructive and moved the draft toward a signable form without revealing our client’s true floor. I proposed a concrete settlement amount above the internal minimum, tightened payment mechanics, and upgraded the release to a mutual release with standard dismissal language to advance the deal in round one.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for circulating the first draft. We have made a few cleanups to move this toward execution: we’ve inserted a concrete settlement amount, added a clear payment deadline, and made the release mutual with dismissal-with-prejudice language. Please review the revised draft below. If your client is comfortable, we can turn this quickly.

edits.text: 2. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD 40,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff’s counsel.
edits.name: Payment clause

edits.text: 3. RELEASE. Effective upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, each party releases and forever discharges the other party, and its respective affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns, from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, or damages of any kind, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this dispute. Plaintiff shall file a dismissal of the action with prejudice within three (3) business days after receipt of the Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Mutual release and dismissal

edits.text: 4. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and existence of this settlement are strictly confidential, except as required by law, court order, or for disclosure to a party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, and immediate family members on a need-to-know basis subject to confidentiality obligations.
edits.name: Confidentiality carve-outs

edits.text: 5. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, fault, or wrongdoing by any party, and may not be used as evidence except to enforce the terms of this Agreement.
edits.name: No admission
